We have a workflow and a set of rules in place to work with the ecore models in unicase. This page describes the workflow for modeling and the modeling rules. Further information about the different models is available[http://teambruegge.informatik.tu-muenchen.de/groups/unicase/wiki/a84b5/unicase_model_documentation.html here]. Possible model transformations during project runtime can be found [http://teambruegge.informatik.tu-muenchen.de/groups/unicase/wiki/bf776/Meta-Model_Transformations.html here].
